name: Citation accuracy
one_line: Proportion of citations that resolve to a chunk actually supporting the cited claim.

formula.notation: A = |{ citations resolving to a supporting chunk }| / |citations|

terms.meaning: the cited chunk id exists in the index for this run
string containment first; LLM judge only where containment fails

range.note: Mathematical range. No typical value is stated: it would be a number with no run behind it.

ci.why: A point estimate over a few hundred queries without an interval is the first thing a reviewer attacks.
